evidence: (a) An equivalent practice exists: SOFTWARE-FACTORY-VISION.md:33 says relevant decisions are recorded and communicated; :97 says to record decisions and distinguish receipt from agreement/acceptance; :107 says to preserve scoped findings in shared knowledge/instructions, notify affected peers, and have recipients assess, adjust, and report adoption or deferral. HERDR-GRAPH-VISION.md:29,35 supplies the same cross-conversation pattern, and DESIGN-NOTES.md:81-83 places behavioral rules in instance instructions. (b) HERDR-GRAPH-VISION.md:29 expressly disclaims shared context or instantaneous agreement; thus the asserted guarantee that the other clone changes course before continuing is outside the stated contract. (c) CURRENT-DESIGN.md:8 and DESIGN-NOTES.md:3 mark this as a design-stage draft; SOFTWARE-FACTORY-VISION.md:157 leaves exact instance practices to design, and HERDR-GRAPH-VISION.md:139-145 frames concurrent operation as a future demonstration, not a completed trial. (d) A worked in-flight requirement-change scenario would improve evaluation, but its absence does not establish a material contradiction or missing adoption practice. A completed empirical trial is not required of this draft.
